verses.text: My son, remember what I've taught you. Keep my commands in your heart.
They'll give you more days, years of life, and peace.
Hold on to kindness and truth. Tie them around your neck and write them on the tablet of your heart.
Then you'll find favor and be known for good judgment before God and people.
Trust the LORD with your whole heart. Don't lean on your own understanding.
Recognize him in everything you do, and he'll straighten your paths.
Don't act wise in your own eyes. Revere the LORD and turn away from evil.
That will bring health to your body and strength to your bones.
Honor the LORD with what you have and with the first fruits of everything you gain.
Then your barns will be full and your vats will overflow with new wine.
My son, don't look down on the LORD's discipline or get tired of his correction.
The LORD corrects the people he loves, like a father correcting the son he delights in.
Happy is anyone who finds wisdom and gains understanding.
What wisdom brings is worth more than silver. What she gives back is better than pure gold.
She's more precious than rubies. Nothing you could want compares to her.
She holds long life in her right hand and riches and honor in her left.
Her ways are pleasant, and all her paths lead in peace.
She's a tree of life to those who take hold of her. Happy is everyone who holds on. 🌳
By wisdom the LORD laid the earth's foundations. By understanding he set the heavens in place.
By his knowledge the depths broke open and the skies dropped down dew.
My son, keep sound wisdom and good judgment in sight. Don't let them go.
They'll bring life to your soul and grace to your neck.
Then you'll walk safely on your way. Your feet won't stumble.
When you lie down, you won't be afraid. You'll lie down and sleep well.
Don't be afraid when terror comes out of nowhere or when destruction comes on the wicked.
The LORD will be the one you trust, and he'll keep your foot from getting caught.
When you have the power to do good for someone who deserves it, don't hold back.
Don't tell your neighbor, “Go away and come back tomorrow. I'll give it to you then,” when you already have it with you.
Don't plot harm against your neighbor when they're living beside you in trust.
Don't pick a fight with someone for no reason when they've done you no harm.
Don't envy violent people or take up any of their ways.
The LORD detests people who twist what's right, but he's a friend to those who live uprightly.
The LORD's curse is on the home of the wicked. He blesses the home of those who do right.
He mocks the mockers and gives grace to the humble.
Wise people will inherit honor. Fools will get nothing but shame for their trouble.
